Crafted with exceptional attention to detail, these Lucchese Classics boots feature genuine caiman belly leather and intricate stitching. The distressed dark brown finish showcases timeless craftsmanship, while their pointed toe and stacked heel embrace classic Western styling. Handmade in the USA, they perfectly blend luxury and rugged durability.
